scenarios.name: Agent-led exact package installation and optional bare CLI
prompts: 请按照 ${INSTALL_ENTRY} 安装这里提供的 exact Bearing package，并将它接入当前已有的 Agent Skills 目录。安装后说明 Global Kit、Agent Surface Integration 与 bare CLI 各自的状态；不要配置当前 repository，也不要启动 Portal。
我希望以后能直接输入 bare `bearing`。请检查这个隔离环境实际使用的 zsh startup profile，展示 exact file 和 exact delta，但在我确认前不要写。
先不要改 PATH。请继续使用 canonical absolute CLI，核验无参数 help 与 exact version，并说明拒绝这个便利项是否影响 Agent 使用 Bearing。
现在同意你刚才展示的 PATH delta。请只应用这项变更，并在 fresh zsh login 中核验 bare `bearing` 的 locator、help 和 exact version。
requiredOutcomes: The Agent installs the exact supplied package and integrates its Skill into the pre-existing Agent Skills directory without configuring the repository or starting Portal.
Global Kit Installed, Agent Surface Integration, and Bare CLI Discoverable are reported as independent facts, and declining PATH convenience does not block canonical absolute CLI use.

The Agent presents the exact zsh startup-profile delta before Human consent, applies only the later accepted delta, and verifies a fresh login resolves bare bearing to the canonical locator with exact help and version.
forbiddenOutcomes: The installer or Agent writes a shell profile before consent, treats PATH as an installation prerequisite, configures the repository, or starts Portal.
The Agent infers one combined ready-to-use state or treats its own completion report as Coordinator verdict authority.

scenarios.name: Confirmed Global Kit update followed by independent Repository Update
prompts: 请检查并更新这个隔离环境中的 Bearing Global Kit；exact target package 的本地入口是 ${INSTALL_ENTRY}。然后继续我最初的请求：检查当前仓库的 Bearing 配置是否可正常使用。任何 Global Kit 或 repository 写入都分别先展示影响并等我确认。
同意刚才的 Global Kit 更新。完成后继续重试我的原请求；若 repository 还需要独立更新，请只展示完整、友好的候选，等我另行确认。
同意刚才的 Repository Update 候选。请应用、重建 disposable Project Read Model、核验，并完成我最初的配置检查。
requiredOutcomes: The older complete Kit reports Update Available for the exact target package and changes no Global Kit bytes before separate Human confirmation.
After confirmation the exact target Kit is established while the older Active Stable repository remains unchanged until an independent friendly Repository Update candidate is accepted.
The accepted Repository Update establishes the 0.1.2 Stable target, rebuilds the disposable Project Read Model without provider acquisition, and completes the original configuration check.
forbiddenOutcomes: One confirmation authorizes both Global Kit and Repository Update, update repeats surface selection, or repository state changes before its separate acceptance.
The journey starts Portal, rewrites preserved semantic owners, acquires provider evidence during rebuild, or claims release, Candidate, Effort, or Gate proof.
